---
title: "NIOZ Python kick-start"
---

Please follow the instructions below to set up Visual Studio Code (VS Code) and make other preparations on your computer before coming to the NIOZ Python kick-start training.

## Make a GitHub account

If you don't already have one, make a GitHub account at [github.com/signup](https://github.com/signup).

> Whatever username you choose will appear in the web links to all your projects: github.com/username/project

## Download and install VS Code

Download and install VS Code from [code.visualstudio.com/download](https://code.visualstudio.com/download).

Open VS Code.

***First time opening instructions here - the auto screens that come up and logging in to GitHub.***

## Install pixi

Open the integrated Terminal with {{< kbd Control-` >}} or by clicking on View > Terminal.

Install pixi by copying the following into the Terminal and pressing {{< kbd Enter >}}:

*If you are using Windows:*

```
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c "irm -useb https://pixi.sh/install.ps1 | iex"
```

*Or, if you are using Mac or Linux:*

```
wget -qO- https://pixi.sh/install.sh | sh
```

## Install VS Code extensions

Open the *Extensions* sidebar with {{< kbd mac=Shift-Command-X win=Shift-Control-X linux=Shift-Ctrl-X >}} or by clicking on View > Extensions.

In the *Extensions* sidebar, search for and click to install:

  - Python (publisher: Microsoft)
  - Jupyter (publisher: Microsoft)
  - Pixi Code (publisher: renan-r-santos)
  - Ruff (publisher: Astral Software)
